Name: Glassworks
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496342-181140443.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It has always bothered me that opening geodes for the minerals inside generally isn't worth it and that the minerals inside don't have any real uses. I also wanted a machine and crafting skill that could grow with a player from the start of the game until the end of the game. Lastly, I really like glass and shiny things in general so I decided to put all three of these things together in this mod.[/color][/size]

[center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496340-1412668260.png[/img][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]A skill with a full skill tree with XP coming from breaking open geodes and making glass items (XP gain is completely configurable)[/*]
[*]3 New machines, 2 tiers of Kiln with open and closed states and a fully animated Artificer (see video for animation)[/*]
[*]30 base game geode minerals have been given 2 tiers of glass art and 5 tiers of decorative glass weaponry (from iron through radioactive)[/*]
[*]The other geode minerals can be traded to the Dwarf for higher tier geodes[/*]
[*]Foraged minerals (quartz, earth crystal, frozen tear, fire quartz, refined quartz) can be turned into glass shards at the mill (or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]watermill[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50640]Watermill Expanded[/url])[/*]
[*]Glass shards are combined with a geode mineral to create art or blades at a Kiln (art is a finished product and blades are used as a base for making decorative glass weaponry). The Kiln recipe is unlocked at level 1 Glassworking. Leah also mails you one once you make it to floor 15 of the mines.[/*]
[*]Handles for glass weaponry, as well as the weapons themselves, are made at the Artificer. Handles are made with a metal bar (with iron and iridium handles able to be further improved with a gold bar). Finished weapons require a handle and a blade. The Wizard will mail you an Artificer once you reach 3 hearts with them. The recipe will unlock at level 4 Glassworking and you can also buy them at the casino for 10k coins.[/*]
[*][u]None of the items are required for perfection[/u], since there are a ton of items[/*]
[*]For a more detailed explanation of how gameplay works, click [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54820]here[/url][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496341-347034944.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]Compatible with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url][/*]
[*]Compatible with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34390]Li[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34390]lybrook[/url]   [/*]
[*]Machines are compatible with Automate and other Automate type mods[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url] adds 3 new tiers of metal bars and 2 new minerals and a second Artificer type which nearly doubles the number of items to make! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url] is required since the new machine requires a remixed item to make and the pricing progression of the items depends greatly on Remixed progression[/*]
[*]Unknown compatibility with Android due to needing Spacecore to work. I intentionally only have Extra Machine Configs requirement at 1.6.0 (the last known version to work with Android). [/*]
[*]Requests for compatibility with other mods are welcome =)[/*]
[*]Want to create your own glass making machines and items? New machines and items can be seamlessly integrated into the mod by using context tags (super easy). I will write an article on how to do this in the coming weeks[/*]
[/list][center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496341-486103444.png[/img][/color][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url][/*]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url] if you want expanded content[/*]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]Watermill[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50640]Watermill Expanded[/url] if you want another place besides the mill to make glass shards[/*]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you want to configure your skill XP and bonus gains   [color=#D4D4D8][size=2]  [/size][/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]   [/color][/size][/*]
[/list][center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496340-830573266.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
Install Spacecore and Extra Machine configs if you have not already and then download this mod and put it in your mods directory. Please leave the folders named and packaged exactly as it is. There are intentionally 2 folders in this mod.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496339-371638583.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url] - Adds progression, special orders, uses, gift tastes, bugfixes and more for Kitsutsune's Chocobo Valley[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50640]Watermill Expanded[/url] - Adds mill functionality and crafting recipes for the paper in Yuninocorn's Watermill building[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52525]Perfumed Candles[/url] - Adds craftable candles using HarrisonGrey's Murmur of Bees and Perfumery mods (Bees Plus version also available)[/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496340-138973838.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[/left]
[list]
[*][url=https://fawaz.is-a.dev/]FawazT[/url] - For making the Glassworks skill, configurations and making it very easy to add new stuff to the skill![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111?gameId=1303]Aimon[/url] - For making the Artificer and Kiln[/*]
[*][url=https://frenchpixelle.itch.io/swords]Frenchpixelle[/url], [url=https://mykar.itch.io/potions-set-50]Mykar[/url], [url=https://mechantcactus.itch.io/350-16x16-magic-items-pack-01]MechantCactus[/url], [url=https://glionox.itch.io/items16]Glionox[/url], [url=https://henrysoftware.itch.io/pixel-item]Henrysoftware[/url], [url=https://zsprites.itch.io/rpg-tools-and-materials-16x16-84-items]Zsprites[/url], [url=https://beowulf.itch.io/mini-weapons]Beowulf[/url], [url=https://jfranci-px.itch.io/pixel-rpg-items]Jfranci[/url] - Item Art[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54820/54820-1793496341-1336242895.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]Mod authors are welcome to make their own machines and items for this skill and release them [u][b]as long as no AI was used and Glassworks is set as a required mod.[/b][/u][/*]
[*]Anyone can create translations or image replacements for things in this mod and release them here on Nexus [b][u]as long as no AI was used.[/u] [/b]Translations and image replacements are allowed to make Donation Points off of their work.[/*]
[*][b]Note to Translators: Feel free to name the glass weapons whatever you want as long as it is still appropriate. I just chose names that I thought sounded good.[/b][/*]
[*]This mod may not be redistributed elsewhere nor may the contents be used to benefit AI.[/*]
[*]The item images in this mod may not be redistributed as I do not have authority to grant that permission. Please support the artists linked above if you really want to use their art. 
[/*]
